# Additions to Esther Chapter 2 (Addition B) — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Additions to Esther B | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/ADE_002_page_001.jpg

---

*[Addition B: The full text of the royal edict ordering the massacre of the Jews — a document the Hebrew Esther only summarizes. The Greek provides it in full, and the reader is meant to hear its polished, bureaucratic evil.]*

**1** This is a copy of the letter: "The Great King Artaxerxes sends greetings to the governors of the hundred and twenty-seven provinces from India to Ethiopia, and to all their subordinate officials:

**2** I have become master of many nations and lord of the whole world. I have not let this make me arrogant; I have always governed with fairness and a gentle hand.

**3** My intention has been to give my subjects a life of lasting calm, and to make my kingdom a place of order, civility, and openness — and so to restore the peace that all people truly want.

**4** I asked my counselors how best to achieve this. Haman rose to answer — the man who leads us all in wisdom, who has proven himself again and again through his loyal goodwill and unshakeable faithfulness, and who holds the second rank in all the kingdom.

**5** He informed us that there exists, scattered throughout all the nations, a certain people who are hostile to every other nation on earth. Their laws stand in direct opposition to every other people's, and they make a habit of ignoring the king's commands. The result is that our honorable and efficient administration of the empire simply cannot reach its potential.

**6** We have understood, therefore, that this is the one people in the world that stands in permanent opposition to all humanity. They operate according to alien laws. They are antagonistic to our government. They do whatever harm they can and refuse to embrace any of the virtues of civilized society.

**7** We therefore command: all those identified to you in the letters written by Haman — who directs our affairs and is to us as a second father — together with their wives and their children, are to be completely annihilated by the swords of their enemies. There is to be no pity. There is to be no mercy. The day is the fourteenth day of the twelfth month, that is Adar, of this year.

**8** Let those who have always been our enemies — and remain so today — go down in a single day in violent destruction to Hades. Then, from that day forward, our affairs will be stable and undisturbed."
